_doc: Oruvel by day: gulls wheel over the raft-town and stand on the cabin roof (top 2.4), Kell's stall (2.0) and the Seventh Terrace (1.5). The sea under the hulls is a solid greybox floor, so no fish until the raft-town kit brings water; no crabs on the decks. Placed on the greybox layout (M3-CRE-615); move the coordinates when env-art's kit replaces the blocks (same keys as ch02_haluna.json). Re-seated on the dressed kit (the Act I audit, 2026-10-29: tools/creatures/wildlife_snap.gd and wildlife_audit.gd, which ray against the zone's visible meshes).
